main_text.p: הוך הֵד Ch. Ire, ambulare, proficisci, vadere: Veni-re, pervenire. Idem quod Hebr. הָלַךְ & יָלַךְ.
הוֹן ופְסֵי Syr. Mente praeditum, Rationis compo-tem esse, Ratione & intellectu uti, Sapere, [Syriac] Vigilantes & Sapientes, seu mente so-brie utentes, 1.ad Thess.5.6.
הות [Syriac] Hiatus, Lucæ 16.26. Tremellius scribit se hanc vocem nullibi praeterea legisse, & ita eam accedere ad Latinam vocem Hiatus, ut eandé esse, & Syriacæ linguæ accommodatam putet.
הי Ch. Particula est, ut Hebraicè אי, quæ variis vocibus præfigitur: ut הירין Tunc, quòd Syrè dicitur, [Syriac] : הירא Quænam, Qualis. Vide etiam in הן.
היך Ch. הירין היכמא Sicut, Veluti, Quasi, Ceu, Quomodo, Quemadmodum: Sic, Ita.
היך נא, היך מה Ch. Sic, Ita: Sicut.
הינא הין Chald. Hin, mensura liquidorum, continens duodecim Logos: Logus autem sex ova.
הכרין, היכרין Quomodo: Vide paulo ante in היך.
*הכי Ch. Sic, Ita: מטול הכי Propterea, Psal.49.15.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Hebrew-letter words are transcribed from the scan and are uncertain in their pointing and exact letters; the Syriac words in particular are only approximated where marked by [Syriac]. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The dictionary line "Ch. Particula est" contains a Hebrew word אי and a Syriac word that could not be fully read. The asterisks before the entries for הכא and הכי are printed marks and are kept.
